name: @databuddy/scan
description: Find product analytics tracking opportunities in your codebase.

scripts.build: bun run check-types && bun run bundle
scripts.bundle:
bun -e "import{readdirSync,chmodSync}from'node:fs';const b=await Bun.build({entrypoints:['./src/cli.ts'],target:'node',format:'esm',minify:true,metafile:true});if(!b.success)throw new AggregateError(b.logs,'Build failed');await Bun.write('dist/cli.js',b.outputs[0]);chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755);const d=new Map();for(const k of Object.keys(b.metafile.inputs)){const i=k.lastIndexOf('node_modules/');if(i<0)continue;const p=k.slice(i+13).split('/'),n=p[0].startsWith('@')?p[0]+'/'+p[1]:p[0];d.set(n,k.slice(0,i+13)+n)}let o='';for(const[n,p]of[...d].sort()){const j=await Bun.file(p+'/package.json').json(),f=readdirSync(p).find(x=>/^licen[cs]e/i.test(x));o+=n+'@'+j.version+' ('+j.license+')

'+(f?await Bun.file(p+'/'+f).text():'')+'

'}await Bun.write('dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES',o)"
